chapter_title_en: The Hunt Turns – Battle With a Core Formation Cultivator
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 389: Han Li's Desperate Stand Against a Core Formation Elder
chapter_meta_description: Cornered on a deserted islet, Han Li must use a pre-set formation and a wounded enemy's own weakness to survive a Core Formation elder's relentless pursuit.
og_title: Record of a Mortal's Journey – The Hunt Turns
og_description: Han Li's last-stand gambit against a six serenity hall elder: a masterclass in mortal stream fighting.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 389 – When the Predator Bleeds
twitter_description: A desperate chase, a pre-set array, and the cold exploitation of an enemy's weakness.

lore_anchors.definition: A speed-focused flying artifact refined from Ink Flood Dragon fin and tail; extremely fast but lacks defensive capabilities.
A water-element formation set by Han Li on the nameless islet, capable of trapping and pressuring an enemy with crushing force and illusory terrain.
The third major cultivation stage; cultivators at this level possess qualitative advantages in mana, tools, and lifespan over Foundation Establishment.
The second major cultivation stage; Han Li is at the late tier of this stage.
A major Chaotic Star Sea faction; Elder Gu is a Core Formation member of this organization.
A cultivator's deepest life-force, distinct from ordinary spiritual power; reckless use can cause severe backlash.
Tools (法器) are used by Qi Condensation and Foundation Establishment cultivators; Treasures (法宝) are wielded by Core Formation cultivators and above, possessing qualitatively superior power.
A artifact that allows a cultivator to direct and manipulate a formation’s effects; Han Li uses the azure banner to intensify the array’s pressure.
